en.intro: Arjuna has just been steadied by Krishna's human form after being overwhelmed by the cosmic vision. Now Krishna explains what Arjuna has just been allowed to see.
en.notice: The most telling thing is that even the radiant beings always long to see this form. The vision Arjuna has just been given is rarer than anything even the divine beings can behold.
en.next: Krishna then says that this form cannot be seen through the Vedas, austerity, charity, or sacrifice.
en.meaning: Krishna says: The form you have seen is very hard to behold. Even the radiant beings long forever to see it.

hi.intro: अत्यधिक विश्वरूप देखकर अर्जुन शांत हुए और कृष्ण ने उन्हें वापस उनका सामान्य रूप दिखाया। अब कृष्ण बताते हैं कि अर्जुन को अभी क्या देखने की अनुमति मिली है।
hi.meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम। देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः॥
hi.notice: सबसे खास बात यह है कि देव भी इस रूप के दर्शन के लिए हमेशा लालायित रहते हैं। अर्जुन को जो दृष्टि मिली है, वह देवों के लिए भी दुर्लभ है।
hi.next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि वेदों, तपस्या, दान या यज्ञ से इस रूप के दर्शन नहीं हो सकते, जैसा कि अर्जुन ने अभी उन्हें देखा है।

en.intro: Arjuna has just been steadied by Krishna's human form after being overwhelmed by the cosmic vision. Now Krishna explains what Arjuna has just been allowed to see.
en.body: Krishna says: The form you have seen is very hard to behold. Even the radiant beings long forever to see it. The most telling thing is that even the radiant beings always long to see this form. The vision Arjuna has just been given is rarer than anything even the divine beings can behold. Krishna then says that this form cannot be seen through the Vedas, austerity, charity, or sacrifice.
